title: Syrian Chicken-Free Curry
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic Syrian dish, featuring exotic and earthy flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the cubed eggplant and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the exotic mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder, cumin, and coriander. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the yogurt and stir until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
